mapper.select: SELECT id, scheme_id, export_status, source_content_version, template_version, hide_price, watermark_enabled, watermark_text, file_expire_at, local_file_key, processing_deadline_at, processing_scheme_guard, record_expire_at, generated_at, error_message, snapshot_json, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM scheme_export WHERE id=#{id} AND created_by=#{actor}

SELECT e.id, e.scheme_id, e.export_status, e.source_content_version, e.template_version, e.hide_price, e.watermark_enabled, e.watermark_text, e.file_expire_at, e.local_file_key, e.processing_deadline_at, e.processing_scheme_guard, e.record_expire_at, e.generated_at, e.error_message, e.snapshot_json, e.created_by, e.created_at, e.updated_at FROM scheme_export e JOIN scheme s ON s.id=e.scheme_id AND s.owner_user_id=e.created_by WHERE e.id=#{id} AND e.created_by=#{actor} FOR SHARE OF s

SELECT id, scheme_id, export_status, source_content_version, template_version, hide_price, watermark_enabled, watermark_text, file_expire_at, local_file_key, processing_deadline_at, processing_scheme_guard, record_expire_at, generated_at, error_message, snapshot_json, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM scheme_export WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT id, scheme_id, export_status, source_content_version, template_version, hide_price, watermark_enabled, watermark_text, file_expire_at, local_file_key, processing_deadline_at, processing_scheme_guard, record_expire_at, generated_at, error_message, snapshot_json, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM scheme_export WHERE processing_scheme_guard=#{schemeId}
SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM scheme_export WHERE scheme_id=#{schemeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO scheme_export (id, scheme_id, export_status, source_content_version, template_version, hide_price, watermark_enabled, watermark_text, file_expire_at, local_file_key, processing_deadline_at, record_expire_at, generated_at, error_message, snapshot_json, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.schemeId}, #{row.exportStatus}, #{row.sourceContentVersion}, #{row.templateVersion}, #{row.hidePrice}, #{row.watermarkEnabled}, #{row.watermarkText}, #{row.fileExpireAt}, #{row.localFileKey}, #{row.processingDeadlineAt}, #{row.recordExpireAt}, #{row.generatedAt}, #{row.errorMessage}, #{row.snapshotJson}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE scheme_export SET export_status='failed', error_message=#{reason}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND export_status='processing'
mapper.select: SELECT id, scheme_id, export_status, source_content_version, template_version, hide_price, watermark_enabled, watermark_text, file_expire_at, local_file_key, processing_deadline_at, processing_scheme_guard, record_expire_at, generated_at, error_message, snapshot_json, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM scheme_export WHERE export_status='processing' AND processing_deadline_at<=#{now} ORDER BY processing_deadline_at LIMIT 100
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM scheme_export WHERE export_status<>'processing' AND record_expire_at<=#{now} ORDER BY record_expire_at LIMIT 100
